Q: weight calculator A:

Weight calculator logic pet calculators mein bhi same rehta hai, bas extra factors add hote hain — breed, age, aur species. Common bugs jo aise calculators mein aate hain: unit mix-up (kg vs lbs, especially agar form default unit set nahi karta), breed-specific variance ignore karna (Chihuahua vs Great Dane ka "ideal weight" formula same nahi ho sakta), aur puppy/kitten ka non-linear growth curve ko adult formula se calculate karna — jo galat result deta hai kyunki young animals ka growth pattern alag hota hai.

Agar aap SO thread 61796492 ka exact code ya error paste kar dein, to main us specific bug ko identify kar ke pet calculator wala comparison bhi natural comment ki shakal mein bana dunga.

Q: How to pass username and password to an application using shell script? A:

Without Security :

You can use this :

 echo "User name: $0"
 echo "Password: $1"

And you can use the particular values using $0 and $1 .

Refer Shell script for more details .

With Security :

read -s -p "Password: " password

Under Linux (and cygwin) this form works in bash and sh. It may not be standard Unix sh, though.

For more info and options, in bash, type "help read".

$ help read
read: read [-ers] [-a array] [-d delim] [-i text] [-n nchars] [-N nchars] [-p prompt] [-t timeout] [-u fd] [name ...]
Read a line from the standard input and split it into fields.
  ...
  -p prompt output the string PROMPT without a trailing newline before
            attempting to read
  ...
  -s                do not echo input coming from a terminal

Q: How to match values between two columns A: 
=LET(
    bID,FILTER(A2:A19,B2:B19<>0),
    bVal,FILTER(B2:B19,B2:B19<>0),
    cID,SORTBY(FILTER(A2:A19,C2:C19<>0),FILTER(A2:A19,C2:C19<>0),-1),
    cVal,SORTBY(FILTER(C2:C19,C2:C19<>0),FILTER(A2:A19,C2:C19<>0),-1),

    bCum,SCAN(0,bVal,LAMBDA(a,v,a+v)),
    cCum,SCAN(0,cVal,LAMBDA(a,v,a+v)),
    totalB,SUM(bVal),
    totalC,SUM(cVal),

    pts,SORT(UNIQUE(VSTACK(0,bCum,IFERROR(FILTER(cCum,cCum<totalB),0),totalB))),
    segEnd,DROP(pts,1),
    amount,segEnd-TAKE(pts,-1),

    E,INDEX(bID,XMATCH(segEnd,bCum,1)),
    F,IF(segEnd<=totalC,INDEX(cID,XMATCH(segEnd,cCum,1)),""),

    HSTACK(E,F,amount)
)

Q: Unable to open Chrome Debugger for React Native App in because of flipper waring Attempting to debug JS in Flipper (deprecated) A:

This is annoying. I don't have a full answer, but I can suggest some workarounds:

  • Run npx react-devtools before tapping Open Debugger in the dev menu. This will give you access to the React component tree.

  • Visit chrome://inspect in Chrome, then select one of the remote targets. The one that worked for me was React Native Experimental (Improved Chrome Reloads). This gives you access to the console and script debugger.

I am also running RN 0.73. I'm hoping it works better in the latest version 🤞

Q: syntax error in visual studio code "expected [css-rcurlyexpected]" A:

If you meant that the error occurs if you uncommend the commented lines, I think VSCode does not like genereated keyframes inside the @keyframes keyword because it expects a valid css keyframes syntax.

I had the same problem and could fix it by replacing the native scss validation in VSCode with Stylelint validation.

  1. Install Stylelint extension in VSCode: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=stylelint.vscode-stylelint
  2. Install Stylelint and SCSS plugin in your project:
npm i -D stylelint stylelint-config-standard-scss
  1. Create a .stylelintrc.json in your project:
{
 "extends": "stylelint-config-standard-scss"
}
  1. Disable native scss valudation and enable stylelint valudation in VSCode config json:
"scss.validate": false,
"stylelint.validate": ["css", "scss"],
